note: Which mobs each damage skill hits (in the order of classes.json's skills), read by the game and the bot (web/town-mobs.ts). single: the target. chain:N: the target, then the nearest live mob within 3 tiles of the last one hit, N in all. cone:N / area:N[:R]: the target and the mobs nearest it within R tiles (2 when not given), N in all. around:N:R: the live mobs within R tiles of the caster (default 1), up to N. line:N: the mobs along the line from the caster through the target (out to the skill's range), nearest first, up to N. hits (below): a skill that lands as several hits. The effects play the skill preview's script with the hit mobs in the slots it uses (combat/skill-slots.ts).

effects.note: What a skill does to each mob it hits besides damage, by class and skill: slow:F:MS (moves at F of its speed for MS ms), root:MS (can't move for MS ms; it still attacks next to you), burn:N:EVERY:SHARE:R:FIRST (a puddle on the target's tile: N ticks EVERY ms apart, the first FIRST ms after the cast, each hitting every mob within R tiles of it for SHARE of the skill's damage). null: nothing. New effect kinds: stun:MS, taunt:MS, dot:N:EVERY:SHARE, heal:F, seek:N:R, charge:MS:MIN, windup:MS, leap:N, crit:F; a comma joins two (Searing Lid). area:N:R and line out to the skill range are shape changes. The first 7 entries of effects stay as they are (pad with null).

fxScale.note: How big a skill's effects are drawn in the world (1 = the art's size), by class and skill.

range.note: How far (tiles) each skill reaches: from how far out its preview's targets stand (1, 3 or 5), at least the class's own reach (5 for the Slingshot and Broom, 1 for the melee classes); an around skill: its radius.

hits.note: New: N:EVERY[:channel|:move] = N hits EVERY ms apart, each 1/N of the damage; null = one hit. Index = the skill's place in classes.json skills.
